public.title: The construction network designed around real work.
public.body: Find trusted companies, skilled people, suppliers and equipment in one clear, multilingual marketplace.
public.heroImageAlt: Modern construction development in Italy with cranes and a finished glass building
public.howItWorksBody: Five account types. One verified construction network.
public.pathCompanyBody: Create or claim an organization, then publish projects, tenders and hiring needs.
public.pathProjectOwnerBody: Publish work, invite providers and compare proposals.
public.pathSubcontractorBody: Find eligible tenders, bid and manage a bid board.
public.pathServiceProviderBody: Publish services and respond to structured RFQs.
public.pathWorkerBody: Show skills and availability, then apply to workforce requests.
public.exploreBody: Featured discovery surfaces that help visitors compare companies, professionals, tenders and active projects quickly.
public.testimonialsBody: Public trust grows faster when the site feels useful, clear and credible before sign-in.
public.ctaTitle: Launch your next verified opportunity with Buildink.
public.ctaBody: From public discovery to protected workflows, the platform is designed to keep trust, speed and clarity moving together.
public.trustBody: Verified profiles, practical opportunities and role-aware workspaces—built for mobile from day one.
public.featureOneBody: Search the people, services and resources your project needs.
public.featureTwoBody: Move from a public opportunity into a clear, protected workflow.
public.featureThreeBody: Track the work that matters from your role-specific dashboard.
